frozen_at: R5 remediation, before any change to PHASE-2-XCHECK.py
authority: PHASE-2-R5-INSTRUCTION finding 3: 'Freeze a checker policy and mutation corpus BEFORE changing the checker. Persist and hash them.'
purpose: This document is the specification the checker must satisfy. It was written before the checker was modified, so the checker is repaired against a fixed instrument rather than the instrument being tuned until the package passes.

invalidation_rule.statement: Any change to PHASE-2-XCHECK.py after this policy is frozen INVALIDATES the mutation run and requires independent review.
invalidation_rule.mechanism: PHASE-2-MUTATION-HARNESS.py records the SHA-256 of PHASE-2-XCHECK.py, of this policy and of the corpus in its result record. A run whose recorded checker digest differs from the digest of the checker at verification time is void.
invalidation_rule.consequence: A CLEAN result carries no weight unless the three digests in the run record match the sealed digests.

execution_environment.python_pinned: CPython 3.10.8 (the interpreter available in this environment)
execution_environment.forward_compatibility_requirement: The checker source MUST compile warning-free under -W error::SyntaxWarning. R5 finding 2 observed a SyntaxWarning on CPython 3.12.13 from an invalid escape sequence that CPython 3.10 accepted silently; the strict compile is therefore a MANDATORY PRECONDITION, not a convenience, because the defect class is version-dependent and would otherwise reappear on a reviewer's newer interpreter.
execution_environment.determinism: No network. No clock. No randomness. No environment variables consulted. Reads only files inside the Phase-2 directory.

exit_codes.2: SELF-TEST FAILED — the checker is not trustworthy and its verdict must be disregarded
exit_codes.3: PRECONDITION FAILED — strict compile or policy/corpus digest mismatch
exit_codes.note: Recorded here, in the checker source, in PHASE-2-MANIFEST.json and in PHASE-2-SEAL.json, per R5 finding 2.

single_rule_object_requirement.statement: Self-test probes and production scanning MUST use the identical compiled pattern object with identical flags.
single_rule_object_requirement.rationale: R5 finding 1: the self-test probed FORBIDDEN patterns with re.I while production scanned without it. The active heading of PHASE-2-LISP-NATIVE-DESIGN.md section 1 therefore evaded rule WC-2 and the R4 CLEAN result was FALSE. A rule tested under different semantics than it runs under is not tested.
single_rule_object_requirement.implementation: Every rule is compiled exactly once into a Rule object carrying its own pattern, flags and id. Both the self-test and the production scan call Rule.search()/Rule.finditer(). No call site may pass flags.

case_policy.forbidden_claims: IGNORECASE. Withdrawn-claim wordings must be caught in headings, table cells and prose regardless of case.
case_policy.counts: IGNORECASE, and spelled-number forms are enumerated explicitly.

no_blanket_exemptions.statement: There is no blanket GENERATED exemption. PHASE-2-SEAL.json and PHASE-2-MANIFEST.json are scanned for stale claims and for prose counts exactly like every other artifact.
no_blanket_exemptions.rationale: R5 finding 5: exempting generated files from prose checks let false active statements survive inside the seal itself.
only_permitted_exemptions: PHASE-2-XCHECK.py — its own source necessarily contains the patterns it searches for
PHASE-2-MUTATION-CORPUS.jsonl — contains the planted defect strings by construction
PHASE-2-CHECKER-POLICY.json — this file, which quotes rule ids and rationale
PHASE-2-MUTATION-HARNESS.py — the harness that applies the corpus
START-THE-LEGAL-WATCHTOWER-PHASE-2.md — the creator directive: a permitted INPUT, immutable, not an artifact
no_blanket_exemptions.canonical_count_lines: Lines matching the canonical-source prefixes (CANDIDATE_IDS, ORIGINAL_SYNTHESES, AUDIT_ROUNDS, DISTINCT_*) are the declared origin of their counts and are exempt from the prose-count rule ONLY on those lines.

required_rule_classes.requirement: Absolute blacklist of withdrawn-claim wordings (WC-n). Any occurrence anywhere, in any case, is a live assertion.
No artifact may restate a current count in prose. Must detect numeric, spelled, capitalised, hyphenated, multiplication-expression and array-length forms.
Every count reported in the seal must equal a value recomputed from the structured records at check time. No hard-coded expected values in the checker.

Exact set equality of UP ids. The canonical enumeration lives in PHASE-2-REQUIREMENTS-AND-INVARIANTS.md Part X. Any other artifact must either reference the canonical list without re-enumeration, or contain a UP id set exactly equal to the canonical set. Re-listing a strict subset is a defect (R5 finding 6).

Defeater statuses in every artifact must match the register; the seal's open list must equal the register's OPEN set; a BOUNDED/ELIMINATED defeater may not be presented as open (status transitions excepted).
Under a PHASE_2_COMPLETE seal every validation field must be literal boolean true. null, missing, non-boolean or false must fail (R5 finding 11).

The seal must not claim zero forbidden-input access while the recorded incident list is non-empty. Content reads and directory enumerations are counted separately and both must be reported (R5 finding 12).
Exactly one candidate marked selected; it must be A6; the seal must name CDAI; every enumerated candidate id must appear in the evaluated-set table.
Structured set equality for I, PO, UP, DF, RL, AC, WC, D and candidate ids.

The staged-admission state machine and the method-combination obligations must be validated against STRUCTURED CANONICAL RECORDS (relations and ordering), not by substring or shape-regex presence. Prose is a rendering of the record, not the source (R5 finding 4).
No sealed inventory entry may be a volatile non-deliverable (dot-directory path). Inventory equality: every hashable member present, no unaccounted member.

mutation_requirements.statement: Every production rule class above must have at least one mutation in PHASE-2-MUTATION-CORPUS.jsonl. Every mutation must make the checker exit non-zero. The untouched baseline must exit 0.
mutation_requirements.coverage_obligation: A rule class with no mutation is an untested rule and the harness reports it as a coverage gap, which is itself a failure.
mutation_requirements.case_variant_obligation: Count and stale-claim mutations must include case variants and spelled-number variants (R5 finding 5).

known_false_clean_precedents: R3: the checker was weakened with historical-context heuristics until it stopped detecting live defects (HF-033).
R4: six count patterns contained literal control characters from shell-escaping damage and could never match (found by negative control).
R4: the first negative-control run was itself invalid because the checker was exiting non-zero on its own broken patterns rather than on detection.

R4/R5: self-test and production used different regex flags, so rule WC-2 was untested in production and an active heading evaded it (R5 finding 1). THIS IS WHY THE FLAG POLICY ABOVE IS A HARD REQUIREMENT.
